title: Cozy Tavern Props
prompt: Cozy fantasy tavern props: a trestle table, a stool, a wooden mug, a candle holder and a wall shelf
interpretation: Chunky, slightly oversized tavern furniture in warm honey wood with soft chamfers, dark painted-iron fittings and warm candle light. One shared palette and bevel size; seat 0.45 m and table 0.76 m keep the pieces at human scale with each other.
